sanskrit: tato bhīṣmasya rājñaś ca niśamya gamanaṃ prati vyavasāyaṃ kariṣye 'ham anunīya pitāmaham
english: Having heard of Bhishma's and the king's intention to depart, I shall appease my grandfather and make my resolve.

sanskrit: tathety uktvā tu te sarve jagmur āvasathān prati vyuṣitāyāṃ rajanyāṃ tu karṇo rājānam abhyayāt
english: Saying "so be it," they all went to their respective quarters. Then, when the night had passed, Karna approached the king.

sanskrit: tato duryodhanaṃ karṇaḥ prahasann idam abravīt upāyaḥ paridṛṣṭo 'yaṃ taṃ nibodha janeśvara
english: Then Karna, laughing, said this to Duryodhana: "A means has been found — hear it, O lord of men."

sanskrit: ghoṣā dvaitavane sarve tvatpratīkṣā narādhipa ghoṣayātrāpadeśena gamiṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ
english: "All the cattle-stations in the Dvaita forest await you, O lord of men. Under the pretext of a cattle-inspection tour, we shall go there — of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit: ucitaṃ hi sadā gantuṃ ghoṣayātrāṃ viśāṃ pate evaṃ ca tvāṃ pitā rājan samanujñātum arhati
english: "For it is always customary to go on a cattle-inspection tour, O lord of men. Thus your father, O king, should rightly grant you permission."

sanskrit: tathā kathayamānau tau ghoṣayātrāviniścayam gāndhārarājaḥ śakuniḥ pratyuvāca hasann iva
english: While those two were thus discussing the resolution to go on the cattle-inspection tour, Shakuni, the king of Gandhara, replied, smiling as it were.

sanskrit: upāyo 'yaṃ mayā dṛṣṭo gamanāya nirāmayaḥ anujñāsyati no rājā codayiṣyati cāpy uta
english: "This means of going there without impediment has been seen by me. The king will grant us permission and will indeed urge us on."

sanskrit: ghoṣā dvaitavane sarve tvatpratīkṣā narādhipa ghoṣayātrāpadeśena gamiṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ
english: "All the cattle-stations in the Dvaita forest await you, O lord of men. Under the pretext of a cattle-inspection tour, we shall go there — of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit: tataḥ prahasitāḥ sarve te 'nyonyasya talān daduḥ tad eva ca viniścitya dadṛśuḥ kurusattamam
english: Then, all of them laughing, they slapped each other's palms. Having resolved on that very plan, they went to see the foremost of the Kurus.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ tataḥ sarve dadṛśur janamejaya pṛṣṭvā sukham atho rājñaḥ pṛṣṭvā rājñā ca bhārata
english: Vaishampayana said: Then they all came before Dhritarashtra, O Janamejaya. Having inquired of the king's well-being and having been inquired of by the king, O Bharata.

sanskrit: tatas tair vihitaḥ pūrvaṃ samaṅgo nāma ballavaḥ samīpasthās tadā gāvo dhṛtarāṣṭre nyavedayat
english: Then a cowherd named Samanga, who had previously been appointed by them and whose cattle were nearby, reported to Dhritarashtra.

sanskrit: anantaraṃ ca rādheyaḥ śakuniś ca viśāṃ pate āhatuḥ pārthivaśreṣṭhaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ janādhipam
english: Thereupon Radheya and Shakuni, O lord of men, addressed Dhritarashtra, the foremost of kings, the lord of men.

sanskrit: ramaṇīyeṣu deśeṣu ghoṣāḥ saṃprati kaurava smāraṇāsamayaḥ prāpto vatsānām api cāṅkanam
english: "In the pleasant regions, the cattle-stations are there now, O Kaurava. The time has come for the annual cattle-census, and also for branding the calves."

sanskrit: mṛgayā cocitā rājann asmin kāle sutasya te duryodhanasya gamanaṃ tvam anujñātum arhasi
english: "And hunting is customary at this time, O king. You should give permission for your son Duryodhana to go."

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca mṛgayā śobhanā tāta gavāṃ ca samavekṣaṇam viśrambhas tu na gantavyo ballavānām iti smare
english: Dhritarashtra said: "Hunting is fine, my dear, and so is the inspection of the cattle. But one should not go trusting the cowherds — that I remember."

sanskrit: te tu tatra naravyāghrāḥ samīpa iti naḥ śrutam ato nābhyanujānāmi gamanaṃ tatra vaḥ svayam
english: "Those tigers among men are nearby there — so we have heard. Therefore I myself do not approve of your going there."

sanskrit: chadmanā nirjitās te hi karśitāś ca mahāvane taponityāś ca rādheya samarthāś ca mahārathāḥ
english: "For they have been defeated by deceit and made to suffer in the great forest, O Radheya, yet they are devoted to austerity and are capable great warriors."

sanskrit: dharmarājo na saṃkrudhyed bhīmasenas tv amarṣaṇaḥ yajñasenasya duhitā teja eva tu kevalam
english: "Dharmaraja might not grow angry, but Bhimasena is wrathful. The daughter of Yajnasena is pure blazing energy alone."

sanskrit: yūyaṃ cāpy aparādhyeyur darpamohasamanvitāḥ tato vinirdaheyus te tapasā hi samanvitāḥ
english: "And you too might give offense, filled as you are with pride and delusion. Then they, endowed with the power of austerity, would utterly burn you."

sanskrit: atha vā sāyudhā vīrā manyunābhipariplutāḥ sahitā baddhanistriṃśā daheyuḥ śastratejasā
english: "Or else those heroes, armed and overwhelmed by wrath, banded together with swords drawn, would burn you with the brilliance of their weapons."

sanskrit: atha yūyaṃ bahutvāt tān ārabhadhvaṃ kathaṃ cana anāryaṃ paramaṃ tat syād aśakyaṃ tac ca me matam
english: "Or if you were to attack them on account of your superior numbers, that would be supremely ignoble — and moreover I deem it impossible."

sanskrit: uṣito hi mahābāhur indraloke dhanaṃjayaḥ divyāny astrāṇy avāpyātha tataḥ pratyāgato vanam
english: "For the mighty-armed Dhananjaya dwelt in Indra's realm, acquired divine weapons, and then returned to the forest."

sanskrit: akṛtāstreṇa pṛthivī jitā bībhatsunā purā kiṃ punaḥ sa kṛtāstro 'dya na hanyād vo mahārathaḥ
english: "The entire earth was once conquered by Bibhatsu even before he had obtained his weapons — how much more will that great warrior now, armed with his weapons, not slay you?"

sanskrit: atha vā madvacaḥ śrutvā tatra yattā bhaviṣyatha udvignavāso viśrambhād duḥkhaṃ tatra bhaviṣyati
english: "Or if, having heard my words, you go there prepared and on guard, the anxiety of dwelling there and the troubles arising from overconfidence will certainly occur."

sanskrit: atha vā sainikāḥ ke cid apakuryur yudhiṣṭhire tad abuddhikṛtaṃ karma doṣam utpādayec ca vaḥ
english: "Or if some soldiers were to do harm to Yudhishthira, that act done without proper judgment would bring a fault upon you."

sanskrit: tasmād gacchantu puruṣāḥ smāraṇāyāptakāriṇaḥ na svayaṃ tatra gamanaṃ rocaye tava bhārata
english: "Therefore let trusted men go for the cattle-census. I do not approve of your going there yourself, O Bharata."

sanskrit: śakunir uvāca dharmajñaḥ pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭhaḥ pratijñātaṃ ca saṃsadi tena dvādaśa varṣāṇi vastavyānīti bhārata
english: Shakuni said: "The eldest Pandava knows dharma, and he pledged in the assembly that twelve years would be spent in exile, O Bharata."

sanskrit: anuvṛttāś ca te sarve pāṇḍavā dharmacāriṇaḥ yudhiṣṭhiraś ca kaunteyo na naḥ kopaṃ kariṣyati
english: "And all those Pandavas are followers of dharma. Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, will not be angry with us."

sanskrit: mṛgayāṃ caiva no gantum icchā saṃvardhate bhṛśam smāraṇaṃ ca cikīrṣāmo na tu pāṇḍavadarśanam
english: "Our desire to go hunting has grown greatly, and we wish to conduct the cattle-census — not to see the Pandavas."

sanskrit: na cānāryasamācāraḥ kaś cit tatra bhaviṣyati na ca tatra gamiṣyāmo yatra teṣāṃ pratiśrayaḥ
english: "No ignoble conduct will take place there. We shall not go to the place where they are encamped."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evam uktaḥ śakuninā dhṛtarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ duryodhanaṃ sahāmātyam anujajñe na kāmataḥ
english: Vaishampayana said: Thus addressed by Shakuni, Dhritarashtra, lord of men, gave permission to Duryodhana along with his ministers — though not willingly.

sanskrit: anujñātas tu gāndhāriḥ karṇena sahitas tadā niryayau bharataśreṣṭho balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
english: Having received permission, the prince of Gandhara, together with Karna, set out — that foremost of the Bharatas — surrounded by a great force.

sanskrit: duḥśāsanena ca tathā saubalena ca devinā saṃvṛto bhrātṛbhiś cānyaiḥ strībhiś cāpi sahasraśaḥ
english: Accompanied likewise by Duhshasana and by the gambler Subala's son, surrounded by other brothers as well, and by women in their thousands.

sanskrit: taṃ niryāntaṃ mahābāhuṃ draṣṭuṃ dvaitavanaṃ saraḥ paurāś cānuyayuḥ sarve sahadārā vanaṃ ca tat
english: To see that mighty-armed one set out for the Dvaita lake and forest, all the townspeople followed him along with their wives.

sanskrit: aṣṭau rathasahasrāṇi trīṇi nāgāyutāni ca pattayo bahusāhasrā hayāś ca navatiḥ śatāḥ
english: Eight thousand chariots, thirty thousand elephants, foot soldiers by the many thousands, and nine thousand horses.

sanskrit: śakaṭāpaṇaveśyāś ca vaṇijo bandinas tathā narāś ca mṛgayāśīlāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
english: Wagons, market-traders, courtesans, merchants, bards, and hunters by the hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit: tataḥ prayāṇe nṛpateḥ sumahān abhavat svanaḥ prāvṛṣīva mahāvāyor uddhatasya viśāṃ pate
english: At the king's departure there arose a very great noise, like that of a mighty wind stirred up during the rainy season, O lord of men.

sanskrit: gavyūtimātre nyavasad rājā duryodhanas tadā prayāto vāhanaiḥ sarvais tato dvaitavanaṃ saraḥ
english: King Duryodhana encamped at the distance of a gavyuta, and then, having set out with all his vehicles, proceeded to the Dvaita lake.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca atha duryodhano rājā tatra tatra vane vasan jagāma ghoṣān abhitas tatra cakre niveśanam
english: Vaishampayana said: Then King Duryodhana, dwelling here and there in the forest, went to the cattle-stations and established his camp there around them.

sanskrit: ramaṇīye samājñāte sodake samahīruhe deśe sarvaguṇopete cakrur āvasathaṃ narāḥ
english: In a pleasant, well-known region, with water and trees, endowed with all good qualities, the men set up their encampment.

sanskrit: tathaiva tatsamīpasthān pṛthagāvasathān bahūn karṇasya śakuneś caiva bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ
english: Likewise in proximity to it, many separate quarters were arranged — for Karna and for Shakuni, and for all the brothers as well.

sanskrit: dadarśa sa tadā gāvaḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ aṅkair lakṣaiś ca tāḥ sarvā lakṣayām āsa pārthivaḥ
english: He saw the cattle there by the hundreds and thousands, and the king noted all of them by their marks and brands.

sanskrit: aṅkayām āsa vatsāṃś ca jajñe copasṛtās tv api bālavatsāś ca yā gāvaḥ kālayām āsa tā api
english: He branded the calves as well, and noted those cows that had newly calved, and also the young calves and the cows he counted.

sanskrit: atha sa smāraṇaṃ kṛtvā lakṣayitvā trihāyanān vṛto gopālakaiḥ prīto vyaharat kurunandanaḥ
english: Having completed the census and noted the three-year-old cattle, surrounded by the cowherds, the joyful son of the Kuru dynasty sported about.

sanskrit: sa ca paurajanaḥ sarvaḥ sainikāś ca sahasraśaḥ yathopajoṣaṃ cikrīḍur vane tasmin yathāmarāḥ
english: And all those townspeople and thousands of soldiers played at their pleasure in that forest, like the immortals.

sanskrit: tato gopāḥ pragātāraḥ kuśalā nṛttavādite dhārtarāṣṭram upātiṣṭhan kanyāś caiva svalaṃkṛtāḥ
english: Then cowherds who were skilled singers, expert in dance and music, attended on the son of Dhritarashtra, as did well-adorned young women.

sanskrit: sa strīgaṇavṛto rājā prahṛṣṭaḥ pradadau vasu tebhyo yathārham annāni pānāni vividhāni ca
english: That king, surrounded by groups of women, joyful, gave them wealth as was fitting, and various foods and drinks.

sanskrit: tatas te sahitāḥ sarve tarakṣūn mahiṣān mṛgān gavayarkṣavarāhāṃś ca samantāt paryakālayan
english: Then all of them together hunted on all sides — hyenas, buffaloes, deer, gayal-cattle, bears, and boars.

sanskrit: sa tāñ śarair vinirbhindan gajān badhnan mahāvane ramaṇīyeṣu deśeṣu grāhayām āsa vai mṛgān
english: He pierced them with arrows, bound elephants in the great forest, and had deer captured in the pleasant regions.

sanskrit: gorasān upayuñjāna upabhogāṃś ca bhārata paśyan suramaṇīyāni puṣpitāni vanāni ca
english: Enjoying dairy products and pleasures, O Bharata, and gazing upon the wonderfully lovely flowering forests.

sanskrit: mattabhramarajuṣṭāni barhiṇābhirutāni ca agacchad ānupūrvyeṇa puṇyaṃ dvaitavanaṃ saraḥ ṛddhyā paramayā yukto mahendra iva vajrabhṛt
english: Frequented by intoxicated bees and resonant with peacock cries, he proceeded in due order to the sacred Dvaita lake, endowed with supreme prosperity, like the thunderbolt-bearing Mahendra.

sanskrit: yadṛcchayā ca tadaho dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ īje rājarṣiyajñena sadyaskena viśāṃ pate divyena vidhinā rājā vanyena kurusattamaḥ
english: And it so happened that on that very day, O lord of men, Dharmaputra Yudhishthira, the king, the foremost of the Kurus, performed a royal-sage sacrifice according to divine rites, with forest products in the immediate manner.

sanskrit: kṛtvā niveśam abhitaḥ sarasas tasya kauravaḥ draupadyā sahito dhīmān dharmapatnyā narādhipaḥ
english: That wise Kaurava, lord of men, having established his camp around that lake, was accompanied by Draupadi, his wife devoted to dharma.

sanskrit: tato duryodhanaḥ preṣyān ādideśa sahānujaḥ ākrīḍāvasathāḥ kṣipraṃ kriyantām iti bhārata
english: Then Duryodhana, together with his brothers, commanded his servants: "Let the pleasure-pavilions be quickly prepared," O Bharata.

sanskrit: te tathety eva kauravyam uktvā vacanakāriṇaḥ cikīrṣantas tadākrīḍāñ jagmur dvaitavanaṃ saraḥ
english: Those obedient attendants, saying "so be it" to that Kaurava, wishing to set up the pleasure spots, went to the Dvaita lake.

sanskrit: senāgraṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya prāptaṃ dvaitavanaṃ saraḥ praviśantaṃ vanadvāri gandharvāḥ samavārayan
english: As the advance guard of Dhritarashtra's son reached the Dvaita lake and sought to enter through the forest gate, the Gandharvas blocked their way.

sanskrit: tatra gandharvarājo vai pūrvam eva viśāṃ pate kuberabhavanād rājann ājagāma gaṇāvṛtaḥ
english: For the king of the Gandharvas had come there earlier, O lord of men, O king, arriving from Kubera's abode, surrounded by his troops.

sanskrit: gaṇair apsarasāṃ caiva tridaśānāṃ tathātmajaiḥ vihāraśīlaḥ krīḍārthaṃ tena tat saṃvṛtaṃ saraḥ
english: With troops of apsaras and the sons of the thirty gods, that pleasure-loving one had come for sport, and by him was that lake occupied.

sanskrit: tena tat saṃvṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā te rājaparicārakāḥ pratijagmus tato rājan yatra duryodhano nṛpaḥ
english: Seeing it occupied by him, those royal attendants then went back, O king, to where King Duryodhana was.

sanskrit: sa tu teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā sainikān yuddhadurmadān preṣayām āsa kauravya utsārayata tān iti
english: But having heard their report, the Kaurava sent soldiers mad for battle, saying: "Drive them away!"

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rājñaḥ senāgrayāyinaḥ saro dvaitavanaṃ gatvā gandharvān idam abruvan
english: Hearing that command of the king, the leaders of his army went to the Dvaita lake and said this to the Gandharvas.

sanskrit: rājā duryodhano nāma dhṛtarāṣṭrasuto balī vijihīrṣur ihāyāti tadartham apasarpata
english: "A king named Duryodhana, the mighty son of Dhritarashtra, is coming here to sport. For that reason, move away."

sanskrit: evam uktās tu gandharvāḥ prahasanto viśāṃ pate pratyabruvaṃs tān puruṣān idaṃ suparuṣaṃ vacaḥ
english: Thus addressed, the Gandharvas, laughing, O lord of men, replied to those men with these very harsh words.

sanskrit: na cetayati vo rājā mandabuddhiḥ suyodhanaḥ yo 'smān ājñāpayaty evaṃ vaśyān iva divaukasaḥ
english: "Your king Suyodhana of dull intellect does not think clearly — he who gives us orders in this way as if we were his subjects, we who dwell in heaven."

sanskrit: yūyaṃ mumūrṣavaś cāpi mandaprajñā na saṃśayaḥ ye tasya vacanād evam asmān brūta vicetasaḥ
english: "And you yourselves are dull-witted and wish to die — of this there is no doubt — you who speak to us thus at his command, you senseless ones."

sanskrit: gacchata tvaritāḥ sarve yatra rājā sa kauravaḥ dveṣyaṃ mādyaiva gacchadhvaṃ dharmarājaniveśanam
english: "All of you go quickly to where that Kaurava king is, and that enemy — go right now to the encampment of Dharmaraja."

sanskrit: evam uktās tu gandharvai rājñaḥ senāgrayāyinaḥ saṃprādravan yato rājā dhṛtarāṣṭrasuto 'bhavat
english: Thus addressed by the Gandharvas, the leaders of the king's army ran back to where the son of Dhritarashtra, the king, was.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tatas te sahitāḥ sarve duryodhanam upāgaman abruvaṃś ca mahārāja yad ūcuḥ kauravaṃ prati
english: Vaishampayana said: Then all of them together came to Duryodhana and reported, O great king, what had been said to the Kaurava.

sanskrit: gandharvair vārite sainye dhārtarāṣṭraḥ pratāpavān amarṣapūrṇaḥ sainyāni pratyabhāṣata bhārata
english: With his army blocked by the Gandharvas, the glorious son of Dhritarashtra, filled with indignation, addressed his troops, O Bharata.

sanskrit: śāsatainān adharmajñān mama vipriyakāriṇaḥ yadi prakrīḍito devaiḥ sarvaiḥ saha śatakratuḥ
english: "Chastise these lawless ones who do what displeases me — even if Shatakratu himself were at play here with all the gods."

sanskrit: duryodhanavacaḥ śrutvā dhārtarāṣṭrā mahābalāḥ sarva evābhisaṃnaddhā yodhāś cāpi sahasraśaḥ
english: Hearing Duryodhana's words, the mighty sons of Dhritarashtra, all of them, armed themselves, and the warriors by the thousands as well.

sanskrit: tataḥ pramathya gandharvāṃs tad vanaṃ viviśur balāt siṃhanādena mahatā pūrayanto diśo daśa
english: Then, overwhelming the Gandharvas, they forcibly entered that forest, filling the ten directions with a great lion's roar.

sanskrit: tato 'parair avāryanta gandharvaiḥ kurusainikāḥ te vāryamāṇā gandharvaiḥ sāmnaiva vasudhādhipa tān anādṛtya gandharvāṃs tad vanaṃ viviśur mahat
english: Then the Kuru soldiers were blocked by other Gandharvas. Being blocked by the Gandharvas, O lord of the earth, yet disregarding those Gandharvas, they entered that great forest.

sanskrit: yadā vācā na tiṣṭhanti dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sarājakāḥ tatas te khecarāḥ sarve citrasene nyavedayan
english: When the sons of Dhritarashtra along with their king would not desist even by words, then all those sky-dwellers reported to Chitrasena.

sanskrit: gandharvarājas tān sarvān abravīt kauravān prati anāryāñ śāsatety evaṃ citraseno 'tyamarṣaṇaḥ
english: The lord of the Gandharvas, Chitrasena, exceedingly wrathful, spoke to all of them regarding those Kauravas: "Chastise those ignoble ones!"

sanskrit: anujñātās tu gandharvāś citrasenena bhārata pragṛhītāyudhāḥ sarve dhārtarāṣṭrān abhidravan
english: Authorized by Chitrasena, O Bharata, all the Gandharvas, weapons raised, charged at the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sanskrit: tān dṛṣṭvā patataḥ śīghrān gandharvān udyatāyudhān sarve te prādravan saṃkhye dhārtarāṣṭrasya paśyataḥ
english: Seeing those Gandharvas swooping swiftly with weapons raised, all of them fled from the battle before the very eyes of Dhritarashtra's son.

sanskrit: tān dṛṣṭvā dravataḥ sarvān dhārtarāṣṭrān parāṅmukhān vaikartanas tadā vīro nāsīt tatra parāṅmukhaḥ
english: Seeing all those sons of Dhritarashtra fleeing with their backs turned, the hero Vaikartana alone did not turn his back there.

sanskrit: āpatantīṃ tu saṃprekṣya gandharvāṇāṃ mahācamūm mahatā śaravarṣeṇa rādheyaḥ pratyavārayat
english: But beholding the great army of the Gandharvas rushing forward, Radheya checked them with a great shower of arrows.

sanskrit: kṣuraprair viśikhair bhallair vatsadantais tathāyasaiḥ gandharvāñ śataśo 'bhyaghnaṃl laghutvāt sūtanandanaḥ
english: With razor-headed shafts, keen arrows, broad-headed arrows, calf-tooth arrows, and iron-shafted ones, the son of a charioteer struck down the Gandharvas by the hundreds, owing to his swiftness.
